headline: Sumar warns the moment is "critical" and that it will dig in its heels if Housing takes "watered-down measures" to the decree
summary: Sumar says the moment is critical and that it will dig in its heels if the Housing ministry waters down measures in the decree. It stresses the coalition was formed to tackle the housing crisis.
why: Housing policy in Spain, including rent and supply measures, affects real estate developers, banks with mortgage exposure and the broader property market.

original_headline: Sumar avisa que el momento es "crítico" y que se plantará si Vivienda lleva al decreto "medidas descafeinadas"
